name: Bluebik Group Public Company Limited
summary: Bluebik Group Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, delivers strategic and digital technology advisory solutions and related support services across Thailand. The company organizes its operations into four core divisions: Management Consulting; Digital Excellence and Delivery; Strategic Project Management Office; and Big Data and Advanced Analytics. Its management consulting offerings cover areas such as business performance enhancement, strategy formulation, marketing and branding development, market entry evaluations, digital transformation initiatives, and comprehensive market research. Bluebik also undertakes strategic project management, which involves overseeing, directing, and monitoring client projects. The digital excellence and delivery segment specializes in creating user experiences and interfaces (UX/UI) for web and mobile applications, coupled with technology development. Furthermore, the company provides extensive services in big data, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence, encompassing the design and implementation of big data platforms, in-depth data analysis, and AI deployment to transform data into measurable value and inform management decisions. Additionally, Bluebik offers IT staff augmentation, assisting clients with the sourcing and outsourcing of IT personnel. Founded in 2013, the company's headquarters are located in Bangkok, Thailand.
